title_sq: Shitet Apartament 1+1 tek Zgjatimi i Rezidences Kodra e Diellit 1
description_sq:
Shitet Apartament 1+1 tek Zgjerimi i Rezidences Kodra e Diellit 1, prane British School. 
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e pare te nje objekti 6 katesh, i ndertuar ne vitin 2017. Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne nje kordior qe shperndan ambjentet, ambjenti i ndenjes, dhoma e gjumi, tualeti dhe nje ballkon.
• Apartamenti eshte i sapo investuar, i pershtatshem per banim apo investim, pasi qirate ne Rezidence variojn 500€ - 600€ ne muaj. 
Zona eshte e qete, e mireadministruar dhe ofron parkim per banoret Rezident. Prona disponon Certifikate Pronesie, pranohen dhe klient me kredi. Per nje vizite me kontaktoni !
title_en: 1+1 Apartment for sale in Kodra e Diellit Residence Extension 1
description_en: 1+1 Apartment for sale in Kodra e Diellit Residence Extension 1, near the British School. The apartment is located on the first floor of a 6-storey building, built in 2017. The apartment is organized in a corridor that divides the premises, the living room, the bedroom, the toilet and a balcony. • The apartment is newly invested, suitable for residence or investment, as rents in the Residence range from €500 - €600 per month. The area is quiet, well managed and offers parking for residents. The property has Certificates of Ownership, customers with credit are also accepted. Contact me for a visit!
